clause: A sale of your Origin Securities by a third party outside your control (such as a margin lender) in a Closed Period or when you are otherwise prohibited by this Policy is a serious breach of this Policy and may result in dismissal.
why_it_matters: Even if a secured facility existed, the bank's enforcement or physical settlement of the collar during a Closed Period would put the executive in serious breach, so the structure cannot rely on lender enforcement rights.

clause: From the date of this Policy, you must not ... enter into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of Origin Securities.
why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar, secured on the collared shares, is expressly prohibited for all personnel and Associates regardless of vesting state, with no approval route; the wording is prospective only and is silent on unwinding pre-existing arrangements.

clause: Dealing in Origin Securities during a Closed Period or Additional Prohibitions will not be permitted.
why_it_matters: No hardship or exceptional-circumstances exemption exists, so collar entry, unwind, roll or settlement must fall entirely within open windows.

clause: If you come to possess Inside Information after receiving clearance to Deal, you must not complete the trade.
why_it_matters: A cleared collar must be priced and executed within the 2-business-day validity and can become unexecutable if inside information arises before signing.

clause: If you hold Origin Securities, you must recognise that a prohibition may apply at the time you wish to sell them, and Origin will have no responsibility to you.
why_it_matters: Undisclosed Additional Prohibitions can block delivery or unwind of shares under the collar at any time, and the executive bears that risk.

clause: You must not ... enter into arrangements which result in short-term Dealing (such as margin loans) to minimise the perception of speculative trading.
why_it_matters: A short-dated collar or one with early-termination triggers may be characterised as an arrangement resulting in short-term Dealing, so tenor should exceed three months.

clause: This Policy also extends to Associates of Origin Personnel. ... a company, partnership or trust over which: (i) you have control or significant influence
why_it_matters: Routing the collar or loan through a family trust or controlled company does not escape the secured financing ban or clearance requirement.

clause: Securities: ... any financial product; derivatives ... Dealing: ... create a derivative over Securities
why_it_matters: There is no venue limitation, so an OTC put and call with a bank is squarely a Dealing subject to clearance and windows.
